title: Relevance to Utility: Process-Supervised Rewrite for RAG
authors: Jaeyoung Kim; Jongho Kim; Seung-won Hwang; Seoho Song; Young-In Song
why_relevant: Proposes a rewriting bridge module to improve document utility in RAG, indirectly addressing low-utility/noisy retrieved evidence, but not focused on robustness, conflict, or calibration.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is improving generation quality via process-supervised rewriting, not robustness under unreliable evidence.
